profile.headline: Software Engineer at Collate
profile.summary:
I am a software engineer working with AWS on a Recommender Engine called Personalize.

I have worked in various tech stacks like Java, Spark, AWS tools, Python, Django, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and much more while working as a Software Engineer at companies like AWS, Goldman Sachs, Addgene and Crest Data Systems.

positions.title: Software Dev Engineer 2
positions.description:
• Currently: Helping build agentic productivity tools with Amazon Quick. Stay tuned...
• Reduced custom model inference deployment time from 30 minutes to about 3 minutes by designing and developing LORA Inference infrastructure working with AWS SageMaker team to efficiently use dynamic multi-adapter inference feature of SageMaker Inference.
• Improved custom model inference TTFT by 30% and accuracy by 20% by building Amazon Bedrock training infrastructure — enabling distillation, reinforcement fine-tuning (RFT), pre-training and fine-tuning workflows — using AWS Step Functions and SageMaker Training containers.
• Ensured 100% billing accuracy across Amazon Bedrock Custom Model Inference APIs by designing metering and billing functionality.
• Developed REST APIs for Amazon Bedrock with Smithy (similar to OpenAPI) with backend in Java, following common REST API design principles, ensuring security, discoverability, pagination, filtering, reliability and performance.
• Developed model customization and on-demand inference UI features for Amazon Bedrock customers using React, improving discoverability and ease of access to model fine-tuning and inference workflows.
• Reduced customer complaints by 50% by engaging and resolving various operational excellence efforts, adding early validation error detection for customers, improving capacity, fixing race conditions, security posture upgrades, and CI/CD best practices.
• Reduced inference latency by 40% and scaled vocabulary support to 5 million items in Amazon Personalize's User-Personalization-V2 recipe by developing core components, including a cold and new item exploration feature for personalized recommendations.
• Designed and delivered an end-to-end Generative AI-powered Personalized Content Generator on Amazon Personalize by building data pipelines, workflow orchestration, and batch processing infrastructure.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed budget tracking APIs for AWS Data Clean Room to enhance privacy controls for the data providers.
• Worked on reducing expenditure in millions as a part of the DynamoDB team by contributing to the compute processor migrations project.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States
positions.description:
• IMD Client Onboarding Team
• Worked as a Full Stack Software Engineer on Client Onboarding application having front-end in React and backend in Java Spring.
• Developed a cache module with the help of Apache Geode to maintain quick and efficient access from a relational database.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Spring Boot · Spring JPA

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description: • Took doubt clearing sessions and assisted with the grading of the class of CS1100 Computer Science and its Applications.

positions.title: Graduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
• Bold undertaking by Prof. Mirek Riedewald and Prof. Armen Stepanyants to create a 3D animated website of Brain circuit images, created by patching of brain images, done with an async workflow to patch different brain images with the help of Map Reduce paradigm.
• Developed backend functionalities with Kubernetes cluster to post the output of patched brain image traces to PostgreSQL database. 
• Improved memory organization of HDFS by 50% by optimizing MapReduce related operations in a Java Spring based web project.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• IMD Client Onboarding team
• Designed visualization dashboards in Kibana to gain client diversity insights and drive operational business decisions reducing hours of time spent on generating such statistics.
• Developed an ETL pipeline in Java with Spring JPA, ingested the data in Elasticsearch, and created dashboards in Kibana.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Spring Framework · Elasticsearch · Kibana

positions.title: Software Development Co-op
positions.description:
• Tech Stack: Django, Python, JavaScript, jQuery, HTML, CSS, Docker
• Revamped the architecture of Label Printing leading to efficient printing of labels for users.
• Contributed to the feature release and improvements for Addgene's internal management website and public website to support order placing and processing.
positions.insights: Skills: Django · Python · JavaScript · jQuery · HTML · CSS · Docker

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
• Worked on the development and improvement of the website of the course CS1100.
• Took doubt clearing sessions and assisted with the grading of the class of CS1100 Computer Science and its Applications.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
• Developed a Splunk application using Splunk Machine Learning toolkit to predict the trends of server loads using time-series analysis.
• Developed ETL solutions for the data gathered from REST APIs, wrote SPL queries in Splunk to create visualizations that would help in monitoring Internet of Things (IoT) devices.
• Designed and developed a Splunk application that helps in monitoring GDPR compliance breaches in client applications.
• Researched and implemented an automation test framework for a Java-based integration platform that reduced the testing time of the application.

positions.title: Summer Intern (Data Science)
positions.description:
• Implemented a news segregation module that would filter the cyber security news.
• Designed a flight booking chatbot using Kore.ai platform to be deployed on channels like Skype, Slack, etc.
positions.insights: Skills: Python · Machine Learning · Chatbot · Kora.ai

volunteerExperiences.description:
• Increased the footfall of Technodyssey fest by 5 times over the previous year while serving as Technical Head of IEEE Student Branch by improving the website design, making challenging technical events, and organizing an Internship Fair for the fest.
• The fest gave a platform to compete and learn various technical topics along with an Internship fair, which connected recruiters with students of the University.

projects.title: Social Media Analysis using MapReduce and Spark
projects.description:
• Tech Stack: Java, Scala, MapReduce, Spark, Hadoop, AWS Elastic MapReduce (AWS EMR)
• Designed and implemented a multi-step reduce-side join and replicated join to analyze cycles in the follower relation from Twitter followers data and deployed it on AWS Elastic MapReduce to analyze the speedup and scale-up of the system.
• Implemented the PageRank algorithm to analyze the ranks of the users based on the number of followers with reduce-side join and replicated join, also deployed on AWS EMR to analyze the speed-up and scale-up.

projects.title: Impact of crime on Housing rates
projects.description:
• Tech Stack: Python, Pandas, ARIMA
• Analyzed the Boston crime data and Boston housing data to find the correlation between crime and housing prices.
• Predicted the trends of crime in various regions and their impact on housing prices in the future.
